integrity: The complete proof identifies the maximal fan cones, integral Cartier support functions, and Smith invariants; the six finite symbolic cases are checks rather than an infinite proof. Existing free-sum and reflexivity results are credited.
scientific_limitations: Over C and with the full standard lattice; a,b>=1, a+b>=3. The normal fan toric variety is considered, not arbitrary degenerations or toric blowups. No classification of singular loci, Cox relations, or independent validation is claimed.
title: Uniform integral Weil–Cartier defects of complete-bipartite unconditional toric Fano varieties
